parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
The period T of the oscillations of a mass m suspended from a spring is given by
T = 2π (m)/(k)
where k is the spring constant of the spring.
The manufacturer of a spring states that it has a spring constant of 25 N m^{-1} ± 8%. A mass
of 200 × 10^{-3} kg ± 4 × 10^{-3} kg is suspended from the end of the spring and then made to
oscillate.
parts.question_text_latex:
The period T of the oscillations of a mass m suspended from a spring is given by
$T = 2\pi \frac{m}{k}$
where k is the spring constant of the spring.
The manufacturer of a spring states that it has a spring constant of 25 N $m^{-1}$ $\pm$ 8%. A mass
of $200 \times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{kg}$ $\pm$ $4 \times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{kg}$ is suspended from the end of the spring and then made to
oscillate.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the period T of the oscillations.
T = s
parts.question_text_latex:
Calculate the period T of the oscillations.
$T = s $

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text:
Determine the value of T, with its absolute uncertainty, to an appropriate number of
significant figures.
T = ± s
parts.question_text_latex:
Determine the value of T, with its absolute uncertainty, to an appropriate number of
significant figures.
$T = \pm s $
